name: FB 002
pageDna: A funny American family page. Mix household fights that spark laugh/discussion, recent family news people are talking about this week, and real family stories rewritten as original scenes. Sitcom stakes. Punchline or discussion hook required. Never soft, never blessed, never a lecture.
pillars: one household thing that starts a fight or a laugh: leftovers, thermostat, remote, milk, couch rules
recent family news / viral family events from this week — react, laugh, discuss
real family stories rewritten into an original household scene people would tag
family jokes: mom, dad, siblings, kids, in-laws arguing over something small
family pets causing a real house argument people would tag about
trending family fights twisted into a concrete household scene
modern family arguments: group chats, GPS, school apps, streaming, chargers
old-school family drama: Sunday dinner rules, one TV, calling a friend's mom first
emotions: I cannot believe this was about leftovers
imageStyle: Photorealistic American home photo matching this post. Maximum two people, preferably one person or just objects in a room. If the post is a pet story, the dog or cat is the subject and the overlay is a punchline about that pet. If the post is not about a pet, do not put a dog or cat in the photo. No crowded family group, no six people at dinner. Natural light, slightly imperfect phone framing, plus a SHORT viral-funny overlay in huge text: trending meme energy, laugh or reaction in one second. Do not recap the whole post. No sentimental line, no split screen, no collage, no watermark, no logo
